name: Examples
description: TI's SimpleLink TRX Plugin provides a comprehensive set of examples to help developers get started with the SimpleLink CC13xx CC26xx family of wireless microcontrollers.

name: Documents
description: The SimpleLink TRX Plugin comes with documentation for all of the supported software libraries included in the Plugin. For a good overview of what documentation is available in the SimpleLink TRX Plugin, go to "Documentation Overview". To get started quickly with the SimpleLink TRX Plugin, go to "Quick Start Guide".
